purpose: Reconstruct the full uncertainty-aware catalogue stages of Sugar et al. (2017) on the blinded SonotaCo 2025 benchmark catalogue, then freeze every parameter and transfer once to SonotaCo 2023.

reference.title: Meteor shower detection with density-based clustering

independent_transfer: SonotaCo 2023 only after the 2025 source, epsilon, randomization, merge implementation, and result are frozen

inherited_constraints: remove solar longitude 20 through 55 degrees before label access
require at least two cameras through the existing frozen SonotaCo parser
remove the existing ESV background exclusion
exclude native shower codes that cannot be mapped through the frozen GMN-MDC audit

field_mapping.radiant_uncertainty: SonotaCo ra sd(deg) and de sd(deg)

benchmark_universe.duplicate_removal: not applicable because the transfer uses one SonotaCo network rather than merged overlapping networks

published_core.feature_vector: six-dimensional Sun-centered GEO vector [cos(sol), sin(sol), sin(lambda_g-sol)cos(beta_g), cos(lambda_g-sol)cos(beta_g), sin(beta_g), vg/72]
published_core.epsilon_rule: 23rd percentile of the fourth-nearest-neighbor distances on the observed quality-filtered SonotaCo 2025 catalogue
published_core.epsilon_transfer: freeze the numeric SonotaCo 2025 epsilon and reuse it unchanged on SonotaCo 2023

uncertainty_cloning.radiant_mapping: independent Gaussian draws in reported equatorial right ascension and declination, followed by the exact frozen equatorial-to-ecliptic transform
uncertainty_cloning.speed_mapping: independent Gaussian draw using reported geocentric-speed standard deviation
uncertainty_cloning.declination_boundary: reflect draws across plus or minus 90 degrees and shift right ascension by 180 degrees until the direction is valid
uncertainty_cloning.speed_boundary: deterministically redraw non-positive speeds from the same event Gaussian until positive
uncertainty_cloning.covariance_limitation: SonotaCo supplies marginal standard deviations but not a full radiant-speed covariance; no covariance is invented
uncertainty_cloning.iteration_seed: stable SHA-256 seed of seed_root, corpus, year, and iteration index

cluster_merging.paper_rule: merge clusters that share at least 50 percent of one cluster's members
cluster_merging.deterministic_interpretation: create an edge between two clone-run cluster instances when their intersection is at least half the size of either instance; master clusters are connected components of this overlap graph
cluster_merging.comparison_scope: cluster instances may be compared across all iterations; same-iteration DBSCAN clusters are disjoint and cannot satisfy the overlap rule
cluster_merging.recurrence: number of distinct clone iterations represented in a master component
cluster_merging.event_membership_probability: number of component iterations in which the event belongs to a component cluster divided by component recurrence
cluster_merging.hard_assignment_for_label_metrics: assign each event to the retained master cluster with maximum membership probability; break ties by larger recurrence, then deterministic component identifier; otherwise assign noise

primary: number of retained, strong, and weak master clusters
hard-assignment normalized mutual information and adjusted Rand index
matched-shower recovery by quality-filtered annual size stratum
secondary: single observed-catalogue deterministic DBSCAN result on the identical quality-filtered universe
evaluation.strong_and_weak_reporting: report strong and weak retained master clusters separately without suppressing either
evaluation.label_access: labels are unavailable to epsilon selection, clone generation, DBSCAN, merging, recurrence filtering, and hard assignment; labels are revealed only for evaluation

integrity_rules: The 1000-iteration count may not be reduced after data access.
The 50-percent overlap rule, 100-run retention threshold, and 500-run strong threshold may not change after data access.
The SonotaCo 2025 epsilon must be recorded before any SonotaCo 2023 access and reused numerically unchanged.
All weak, negative, fragmented, or merged outcomes must be retained.
The result must remain labelled a catalogue-scale uncertainty-pipeline reconstruction, not an episode comparison.
No fixed4 parameter, score, gate, or outcome may change.
The pipeline may not inspect OrbitTrace coordinates, members, scores, or targeted-recovery results.
claim_boundary: The paper does not publish source code or a more detailed merge order. The connected-component overlap graph is a preregistered deterministic interpretation of the stated 50-percent rule. The SonotaCo marginal-error mapping is a survey transfer, not an exact reproduction of the ASGARD covariance model.
